# Insightfull Web Research SDK

> LLM integration instructions for @insightfull/web-research-sdk

## Packages

- `@insightfull/web-research-sdk` — core client, browser capture runtime, and overlay bridge. Install this first.
- `@insightfull/web-research-sdk-react` — optional React provider, hooks, and iframe host component. Requires the core package plus `react` >= 18 and `react-dom` >= 18.
- `@insightfull/web-research-sdk-shared` — internal workspace package. Not published. Do not install or import.

## Install

Core only:

```
yarn add @insightfull/web-research-sdk
```

Core + React:

```
yarn add @insightfull/web-research-sdk @insightfull/web-research-sdk-react react react-dom
```

## Minimal core example

```ts
import {
  createWebResearchClient,
  createCallbackTransport,
} from "@insightfull/web-research-sdk";

const client = createWebResearchClient({
  apiKey: "public-sdk-key",
  transport: createCallbackTransport({
    onBatch(batch) {
      console.log(batch.events);
    },
  }),
});

const session = client.startBrowserSession();
```

## Minimal React example

```tsx
import { createElement } from "react";
import {
  WebResearchProvider,
  createReactWebResearchClient,
  OverlayBridgeFrame,
} from "@insightfull/web-research-sdk-react";

const client = createReactWebResearchClient({
  apiKey: "public-sdk-key",
  bridge: {
    iframeOrigin: "https://overlay.example.com",
    parentOrigin: window.location.origin,
    handshake: {
      overlayToken: "overlay-runtime-token",
      overlayTokenExpiresAt: "2026-04-01T00:00:00.000Z",
      context: {
        organizationId: 1,
        studyId: 10,
        sectionId: 20,
        sessionId: "session-123",
        tabId: "tab-1",
      },
      uiConfig: {
        defaultPosition: "bottom-right",
        showAiPersona: true,
      },
      consent: { mode: "required", captureAllowed: true },
    },
  },
});

function App() {
  return createElement(
    WebResearchProvider,
    { client },
    createElement(OverlayBridgeFrame, {
      src: "https://overlay.example.com/embed",
      title: "Insightfull overlay",
    }),
  );
}
```

## Core exports

- `createWebResearchClient(options)` — create a client
- `createCallbackTransport(options)` — transport that calls functions on flush/complete
- `createPostMessageTransport(options)` — transport that sends via postMessage
- `WebResearchEventQueue` — event batching queue
- `BrowserWebResearchSession` — browser capture runtime
- `OverlayBridgeRuntime` — overlay bridge state machine
- `createBridgeMessageEnvelope(options)` — create typed bridge messages
- `validateBridgeOrigin(input)` — validate message origins
- `validateSupportedBridgeVersion(requested)` — check bridge version support
- `SUPPORTED_BRIDGE_VERSIONS` — supported protocol versions
- Type exports: `WebResearchClient`, `WebResearchClientOptions`, `WebResearchTransport`, `BrowserSessionController`, `OverlayBridgeController`, `OverlayBridgeSnapshot`, `SdkLifecycleState`, `BridgeVersion`, `BridgeCapability`, `BridgeMessageType`, and more

## React exports

- `WebResearchProvider` — context provider
- `createReactWebResearchClient(options)` — client factory for React apps
- `useWebResearchClient()` — hook that returns the client from context
- `useMaybeWebResearchClient()` — returns client or null
- `useOverlayBridgeStatus(client?)` — derived bridge status flags
- `useOverlayBridgeSnapshot(client?)` — full bridge snapshot
- `getOverlayBridgeStatus(snapshot)` — non-hook status derivation
- `OverlayBridgeFrame` — drop-in iframe component with secure defaults
- `useOverlayBridgeHost(options)` — lower-level iframe/bridge hook
- `mergeOverlayIframeRef(...refs)` — ref merging utility

## Constraints

- `iframeOrigin` must be an explicit `https` origin (no wildcards)
- Do not put overlay or session tokens in iframe URL query params
- This SDK does not ship proprietary overlay/interview logic — that runs in a private hosted iframe
- Browser capture defaults are privacy-safe: no raw element text, no input values, navigation URLs redacted to origin + pathname
- The bridge validates origin and protocol version on every message; unknown messages are rejected
